steps.text: Cash break on income account GRW-012-INC (GBP): IBOR GBP 206,245.11 vs custodian GBP 202,293.75. Income cash only moves on dividends and coupons, so I'll look for entries that exist on one side only.
income cash balance on both books
Confirmed: custodian is below IBOR by GBP 3,951.36. Looking for entries that only one book has.
cash entries on one side only
0 one-sided entries totalling GBP 0.00 against a break of GBP 3,951.36.

queries.sql:
SELECT
  b.break_id,
  b.as_of,
  b.account_id,
  b.security_id,
  s.ticker,
  s.isin,
  s.currency AS sec_ccy,
  s.country,
  b.currency,
  b.break_type,
  b.ibor_value,
  b.custodian_value,
  b.difference,
  b.difference_usd,
  b.status
FROM breaks AS b
LEFT JOIN securities AS s
  ON s.security_id = b.security_id
WHERE
  b.break_id = 'BRK-0026'
LIMIT 200

queries.purpose: income cash balance on both books
queries.sql:
SELECT
  *
FROM (
  SELECT
    'IBOR' AS book,
    balance
  FROM ibor_cash_balances
  WHERE
    account_id = 'GRW-012-INC' AND currency = 'GBP'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'CUSTODIAN' AS book,
    balance
  FROM custodian_cash_balances
  WHERE
    account_id = 'GRW-012-INC' AND currency = 'GBP'
) AS u
LIMIT 200

queries.purpose: cash entries on one side only
queries.sql:
SELECT
  *
FROM (
  SELECT
    c.entry_id,
    c.value_date,
    c.entry_type,
    c.amount,
    c.reference,
    'CUSTODIAN_ONLY' AS side
  FROM custodian_cash_activity AS c
  LEFT JOIN ibor_cash_activity AS i
    ON i.account_id = c.account_id AND i.reference = c.reference
  WHERE
    c.account_id = 'GRW-012-INC'
    AND c.currency = 'GBP'
    AND c.value_date >= '2026-11-05'
    AND i.entry_id IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    i.entry_id,
    i.value_date,
    i.entry_type,
    i.amount,
    i.reference,
    'IBOR_ONLY' AS side
  FROM ibor_cash_activity AS i
  LEFT JOIN custodian_cash_activity AS c
    ON c.account_id = i.account_id AND c.reference = i.reference
  WHERE
    i.account_id = 'GRW-012-INC'
    AND i.currency = 'GBP'
    AND i.value_date >= '2026-11-05'
    AND c.entry_id IS NULL
) AS u
LIMIT 200
